description: Xiahou Dun, fierce chinese general in the supplied pixel art style. Dark helmet with a blue plume, dark armor with gold trim and blue cloth, long blue cape, dark boots. He holds a long spear with a dark shaft, gold fittings and a silver leaf-shaped blade
face: A black eye patch over his left eye, scowling face with a short dark beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the back of the dark helmet with the blue plume, the long blue cape covering the back, the spear at his right side.
guard_action: both hands take the spear and bring it to a ready angle at the right side, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Spearman fighting guard, spear held in both hands, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the spear, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: One straight two-handed spear thrust. Frames 1-5 the weight goes back and the spear is drawn level; frames 6-8 one big step and a straight thrust at waist height; frames 9-11 hold the reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b1: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the whole upper body winds far to the right with the spear held level; frames 7-8 the spear is swung around from the side to the front in a wide flat arc; frames 9-11 hold in front. The spear travels sideways, it is not a thrust. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Leaping downward spear strike. Frames 1-4 he sinks; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground with the spear raised over the right shoulder; frame 8 he lands driving the spear down into the target; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Unyielding brace. Frames 1-6 the spear is held across the body like a bar in both hands and he sinks into a deep crouch; frame 8 he pushes the bar outward and stands firm; frames 9-12 hold. Both feet stay planted. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: VERTICAL overhead spear strike. Frames 3-6 both hands raise the spear straight up above the head, pointing at the sky; frames 7-8 it is brought down from above onto the target; frames 9-11 hold with the tip low.
actions.c5: Pursuit, two thrusts. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a full thrust; frames 7-9 half a withdrawal; frame 10 a second faster thrust; frames 11-12 hold.

notes: 2026-11-19. 평타 a1(직창) → b1(가로 휘두르기) → a3(도약 내려찍기), 전법 s2(불굴). 창 138px, 장비처럼 측면만 캔버스에서 30px 옮긴다.
